lae_algangror2_10.m: Now we are all locked in here! We will all starve to death!

lae_algangror2_30.m: Our only chance of survival lies in that stairway over there.
r: You didn't try it yourself yet?
Why did all that gold disappear for a few moments?

lae_algangror2_32.m: Did it? You must have dreamed that.

lae_algangror2_50.m: We can't use those stairs. Some invisible force holds us back. But maybe you can do it?
r: OK you weaklings - I'll show you.
Well, I could at least try.

lae_centaurs.10: The island west of Remgard was inhabited by centaurs who were very angry about your visit. They told me to seek out their leader, Thalos. He should be in the northeast of the island.
lae_centaurs.30: He ordered me to slay a foul creature that hides in a cave on the hills of Laeroth Island, because the centaurs can't enter it.
lae_centaurs.110: In the cave entrance I have met Algangror, who asked for help.
lae_centaurs.112: In a cave entrance I have met Jhaeld of Remgard, who asked for help.
lae_centaurs.120: A common friend would be trapped deeper in the cave and I should free him.
lae_centaurs.130: Down in the cave I have found my brother Andor, locked in a room with no doors or other entrances.
lae_centaurs.140:
To open an entrance I had to find the four scrolls of elements and the three color globes. These were hidden all over the island.
The scrolls and globes would need to be properly placed around Andor's golden prison.
lae_centaurs.150: The wall opened and gave access to the interior of the room.
lae_centaurs.160: With an intense sound, the wall built up again. I've been locked up!
lae_centaurs.170: The only way out was down a staircase, which, however, seemed to be magically secured.
lae_centaurs.180: The only way out was down a staircase, which, however, seemed to be magically secured.
lae_centaurs.190: It was no problem going downstairs, but something was wrong there.
lae_centaurs.200: The whole thing was just a big scam to lure me into this cave to serve Dorhantarh as dinner.
lae_centaurs.210: The moment I placed the Scroll of Fire on the table, it exploded. At the same time the wall opened again.
lae_centaurs.300: I brought the monster's heart to Thalos and told him that the danger has been averted. He was impressed and relieved at the same time.
lae_centaurs.310: Since then I have been a welcome guest of the centaurs.
